caption.en: A developer and a product manager clarify when a form's submit button should be enabled.
caption.zh: 开发者与产品经理确认，表单的提交按钮应当在什么条件下启用。

description.en: A developer and a product manager clarify when a form's submit button should be enabled.
description.zh: 开发者与产品经理确认，表单的提交按钮应当在什么条件下启用。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 你能澄清一下这项需求吗？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: The button should stay disabled until all required fields are filled in.
dialogue.zh: 在所有必填项填写完成之前，按钮应保持禁用。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: So the user can submit only after completing the form?
dialogue.zh: 也就是说，用户必须填完表单才能提交，对吗？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Exactly. Let's check the screen together.
dialogue.zh: 没错。我们一起看一下屏幕。

dialogue_storage: PicLex 关键词标签 learning.example/exampleChinese 保存 canonical A,B,A,B 4 话轮对白（A=学习者朗读评分，B=机器朗读不评分，角色标记不朗读）；角色说明仅保留在 cards.roles 元数据；cards.targets 各词 example_en/example_zh 仍为定稿摘录。
communication_goal: 提问并复述理解，确认需求条件。
image_prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE standalone finished educational scene illustration, square 1024x1024. Pure white background, clean consistent black line art, minimalist adult stick figures with circular heads, simple expressive faces and thin limbs, restrained polished programmer workplace comic aesthetic. No color, no gradients, no shading, no photographic rendering. One coherent scene, no panels. Keep all people and props in the central area approximately x=180..820 and y=220..790 on a 0..1000 canvas. Preserve generous empty white space at top (y<180), bottom (y>850), and sides for learning labels added later. Make the named learning props clearly recognizable and fully visible. Gestures should show a conversation. No speech balloons, captions, logos, watermarks, readable code, or long text; simple abstract UI marks are allowed. Scene: Two adult stick-figure coworkers, a developer at left and a product manager at right, discussing one large desktop monitor at center. Both gesture toward its screen. The monitor displays a very simple web form: two empty outlined input fields near the top and ONE distinct rounded rectangular submit button near the lower center. Make the screen and the single button large, unobstructed, and easy to box separately. No text is needed inside the UI. A low simple desktop supports the monitor.

image_review.summary: 通过：开发者和产品经理共同指向带两栏输入框与一个按钮的表单。按钮、屏幕明确可分开框选，人物表情和黑白线条符合风格。启用条件由对白表达，不从空白UI推断运行状态。
